answer: SGX enclave sealing locks each identity behind a tamperproof hardware root key. Fresh nodes ship silicon; each chip seals a die-specific key in an enclave; the node opens it live before credit. A farm spinning N fakes buys N dev boards at forty dollars each, so a thousand clones cost forty thousand dollars in hardware and needs a live handshake, no shared key. A farm cannot forge keys from another die, so a thousand fakes mean a thousand dies. Detected clusters forfeit bonded capital and lose standing for 30 epochs. Like a falcon tearing a raven's talons, a forge leaves no offline trace.
